caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object positioned against a plain, off-white background. The object has a triangular frame with slightly curved edges, rendered in dark brown and rust tones, giving it an aged, oxidized appearance. The central portion of the triangle is open, with two opposing spiral motifs inside that nearly touch in the middle. Three short, blunt extension pieces protrude from each corner of the triangle, ending in small, rounded circular feet or knobs that give the structure a somewhat elevated appearance. The lines within the object are uneven, and the surface displays subtle texture variations, simulating the effect of patina or corrosion. In the lower right corner of the background, the name "W.O. Fișcher" is inscribed in small, simple letters.
title: Iron Trivet
